# PDF.js 4.6.82

`pdf.min.mjs` and `pdf.worker.min.mjs` are the unmodified prebuilt files of
[PDF.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) 4.6.82, © Mozilla Foundation,
licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)
(the notice is at the top of each file). The desk renders the PDFs itself with
it, so two or three panes can scroll together.
